title: Catalan Paella Vegan Delight
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this vegan paella is made with velvety vegetables and flavorful catalan spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the artichoke hearts, tomatoes, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the rice to the pan and stir to coat with the vegetable mixture.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
